jobs.title: Head of AI
jobs.description: About Poesis Whoever builds the leading intelligence for finance will create far more than returns. Poesis is the AI-native investment firm running autonomous agents that predict markets, construct portfolios, and manage risk. Our founders managed institutional capital at Capital Group ($3T AUM) and led enterprise ML at Goldman Sachs and Amazon. We're building a new type of firm, where live capital is the training ground for an intelligence that compounds with every signal. About the Role Financial markets offer something rare in AI research: a continuous, objective feedback loop where you can test new ideas, measure whether they actually work, and use real-world outcomes to inform what you build next. It’s an opportunity to do frontier research with a direct line between the ideas you explore and their real-world performance. As Head of AI, you’ll lead Poesis’s AI strategy and research, setting the technical direction for how we apply frontier AI to investing. You’ll explore new AI approaches, tackle difficult research problems and help define how we use AI to better understand and predict financial markets. This is a hands-on leadership role where you’ll set the research agenda while continuing to work directly on technical challenges. Challenges You’ll Work On Set Poesis’s AI research direction, identify the hardest problems worth solving and guide the team's technical work. Push the capabilities of foundation models, agentic systems and world models through new architectures and research approaches. Explore pre-training, mid-training and post-training methods to improve how models learn, reason and adapt. Advance tabular ML research, including emerging methods such as prior-data fitted networks (PFNs). Tackle the challenges of learning from small, high-dimensional datasets where traditional ML methods struggle. Turn promising research into models and systems that can solve difficult real-world problems. About You You’ve done exceptional AI research at a frontier

We collaborate closely on complex technical problems, working in pairs or using mob programming to resolve challenging issues. New team members learn through real work: from your first weeks you will pair with experienced researchers on live problems, and take on more ownership as you grow into it. BSI merupakan bank hasil merger antara PT Bank BRI syariah Tbk, PT Bank Syariah Mandiri dan PT Bank BNI Syariah. Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) secara resmi mengeluarkan izin merger tiga usaha bank syariah tersebut pada 27 Januari 2021 melalui surat Nomor SR-3/PB.1/2021. Didukung sinergi dengan perusahaan serta komitmen pemerintah melalui Kementerian BUMN, BSI didorong untuk dapat bersaing di tingkat global. Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk Saat ini PT Bank Syariah Indonesia (BSI) membuka kesempatan untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: Private Banking Relationship Manager Key Responsibilities: Build and manage long-term relationships with High Net Worth Individuals (HNWIs) and affluent clients Provide tailored wealth management, investment, and financial planning solutions aligned with clients financial goals Grow Assets Under Management (AUM) through portfolio development, client acquisition, and relationship expansion Deliver holistic advisory services across investment, protection, and wealth preservation solutions Identify new business opportunities through networking, referrals, and market engagement Maintain the highest standards of client service, professionalism, confidentiality, and regulatory compliance Requirements: Bachelor s Degree (S1) from any discipline. Bank ini menjadi bank pertama yang memelopori pertukaran mata uang asing dengan menjadi bank devisa pertama di Indonesia. Berikut ini adalah Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Danamon Indonesia Tbk. PT Bank Danamon Indonesia Tbk (IDX Code: BDMN) yang berdiri sejak 1956, per 30 Juni 2021 mengelola total aset konsolidasi sebesar Rp 194 triliun bersama anak perusahaannya, yaitu PT Adira Dinamika Multi Finance Tbk. (Adira Finance). Dalam hal kepemilikan saham, 92,47% saham Danamon dimiliki oleh MUFG Bank, Ltd. dan 7,53% dimiliki oleh publik. Danamon didukung oleh 846 jaringan kantor cabang konvensional, unit Syariah dan kantor cabang anak perusahaannya serta lebih dari 60.000 jaringan ATM Danamon, ATM Bersama, PRIMA dan ALTO yang tersebar di 34 provinsi. Selain jaringan fisik, layanan Danamon juga dapat diakses melalui Danamon Online Banking, mobile banking melalui aplikasi D-Bank dan D-Card, SMS Banking, serta layanan phone banking melalui Hello Danamon. Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Danamon Indonesia Tbk Saat ini PT Bank Danamon Indonesia Tbk memberikan kesempatan lowongan kerja untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: Danamon Banking Officer Funding Placement: Jawa Timur & Bali Nusra Program pendidikan fokus pembelajaran terkait keterampilan teknis produk dan bisnis serta pengembangan pribadi agar peserta program siap menjadi Relationship Manager Funding maupun Relationship Manager Lending untuk ditempatkan pada fungsi kerja Branch Network dan Mortgage di seluruh Indonesia. Kualifikasi Fresh graduate S1 segala jurusan, IPK minimal 2,75 (skala 4) dan/atau berpengalaman kerja maksimal 1 tahun. Memiliki kemampuan interpersonal dan komunikasi yang baik. Memiliki kemampuan analisis yang baik. Menyukai kegiatan/aktivitas penjualan. Berorientasi pada target serta memi
